mission.title: atlantis: Bitbucket Cloud Atlantis Incompatibility After App Password Deprecation
mission.description: Bitbucket Cloud Atlantis Incompatibility After App Password Deprecation. This issue affects 21+ users.

steps.title: Identify atlantis troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your atlantis deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n atlantis -l app.kubernetes.io/name=atlantis
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=atlantis -n atlantis --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for error: `Authentication failed for 'https://bitbucket.org/acme/atlantis-demo.git/'`

steps.title: Review atlantis configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant atlantis configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n atlantis -l app.kubernetes.io/name=atlantis
kubectl get configmap -n atlantis -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=atlantis
```
### Community Note

* Please vote on this issue by adding a 👍 [reaction](https://blog.github.com/2016-03-10-add-reactions-to-pull-requests-issues-and-comments/) to the original issue to help the community and maintainers prioritize this request.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Bitbucket Cloud Atlantis Incompatibility After App Password…
steps.description:
Apply the configuration change to resolve the issue:
```yaml
repos:
  - id: bitbucket.org/acme/atlantis-demo
    allow_custom_workflows: true
    policy_check: false
    apply_requirements: [approved, mergeable]
    allowed_overrides: [workflow, apply_requirements]
    pre_workflow_hooks:
      - run: python3 /usr/local/bin/generator.py
   
metrics:
  prometheus:
    endpoint: "/metrics"
```

steps.title: Confirm Bitbucket Cloud Atlantis Incompatibility After… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=atlantis -n atlantis --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n atlantis --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that `Authentication failed for 'https://bitbucket.org/acme/atlantis-demo.git/'` no longer appears in logs.

resolution.summary: See the source issue for the community-verified solution: https://github.com/runatlantis/atlantis/issues/5696
